messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Hindi) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition (dative) – marks “to you” | **A** | “A” (kept verbatim) | UNNECESSARY | | **te** | 2nd‑person singular pronoun (accusative) – “you” (object) | **तुम्हें** | “you (dative)” | OK | | **convien** | impersonal verb – expresses necessity/obligation | **आवश्यक** | “necessary / obligatory” | OK | | **tenere** | infinitive – “to hold / keep” | **रखना** | “to hold / keep” | OK | | **altro** | adjective – “another / a further” | **एक और** | “one more / another” | OK | | **vïaggio** | noun – “journey / course” | **यात्रा** | “journey” | OK | | **rispuose** | verb – “he replied” (speech act) | **उसने उत्तर दिया** | “he replied” | OK | | **poi** | adverb – temporal “when” (introduces subordinate clause) | **जब** | “when” | OK | | **che** | conjunction – links “poi” to the subordinate clause | — (absorbed in **जब**) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **lagrimar** | infinitive – “weeping” (action observed) | **रोते** | “weeping” | OK | | **mi** | 1st‑person pronoun (accusative) – “me” | **मुझे** | “me” | OK | | **vide** | verb – “saw” (perception) | **देखा** | “saw” | OK | | **se** | conjunction – conditional “if” | **यदि** | “if” | OK | | **vuo'** | verb (volere) – “wish / want” | **चाहते** | “wish / want” | OK | | **campar** | infinitive – “to escape / get away” | **बचना** | “to escape” | OK | | **d'esto** | preposition + demonstrative – “from this” | **से इस** | “from this” | OK | | **loco** | noun – “place” | **स्थान** | “place” | OK | | **selvaggio** | adjective – “savage / wild” | **जंगली** | “savage / wild” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** - **A** – the Italian dative preposition is not needed in Hindi because case is expressed by the post‑position *‑को*/*‑को* (here rendered by *तुम्हें*). - **che** – Hindi does not require a separate conjunction after *जब*; the meaning is already captured.
All other source tokens are correctly rendered (OK).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 1:** - Original: **A तुम्हें एक और यात्रा रखना आवश्यक है,** - Issue: UNNECESSARY Latin character “A” (not part of Hindi script) - Corrected: **तुम्हें एक और यात्रा रखना आवश्यक है,**
- **Line 2:** - Original: **उसने उत्तर दिया जब उसने मुझे रोते हुए देखा,** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 3:** - Original: **यदि तुम इस जंगली स्थान से बचना चाहते हो;** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
```text तुम्हें एक और यात्रा रखना आवश्यक है, उसने उत्तर दिया जब उसने मुझे रोते हुए देखा, यदि तुम इस जंगली स्थान से बचना चाहते हो; ```
